LESSON: POSITION AND SIZE OF COUNTRIES IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Afr
Topic 1.1: Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you determine the position of countries in Eastern Africa?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the countries of Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the position and size of countries in Eastern Africa
3. use latitudes and longitudes to locate places on a map
4. appreciate the unity of Eastern African countries

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: POSITION AND SIZE OF COUNTRIES IN EASTERN AFRICA
This lesson teaches Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa for Grade 6 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the countries of Eastern Africa on a map
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe the position and size of countries in Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. use latitudes and longitudes to locate places on a map
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the unity of Eastern African countries
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa above.
2. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT
